summary: The test is syntactically correct and uses Playwright APIs properly, but the selector and assertion are weak. The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' appears specific but may not be dynamic, and the URL assertion is generic, only checking for '/product/' without verifying the exact product page. No evidence of test data handling or maintainability improvements. No misuse of asynchronous code or Locator API.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be hard-coded and not dynamic, which can reduce test flexibility.
issues.recommendation: Consider parameterizing the selector or using a more robust method to identify the product.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a loose regular expression /product/ which may pass for unintended URLs.
issues.recommendation: Use a stricter URL match or assert page content to ensure the correct product detail page is loaded.

recommendations: Enhance URL assertion to check for full expected product URL or page-specific elements.
Parameterize selectors to improve test maintainability and reusability.
Add assertions verifying key product details to strengthen the test validity.
